scientific_role: describe when nearest-known proximity is more or less informative; not a preregistered gate and not a validation result
interpretation: More replicated historical occurrence clusters make nearest-known proximity more informative, but even the 8+ anchor bin recovers only 16.2% of later novel clusters at 2 km, 32.4% at 5 km and 48.9% at 10 km. Anchor replication can therefore inform a LOCAL_CONTINUATION evidence gate, but distance itself remains insufficient as the primary selector.
forbidden_use: do not promote 8+ historical clusters as a production threshold from this post-result diagnostic
do not tune distance radii from these bins
do not present the correlations as independent confirmation
do not replace structural/environmental selection with nearest-known distance
